title: Knowledge indicators for an outcome-based framework
description:
Washington Accord WK indicators, or a body's equivalent.

These live in their own file rather than inside the outcome set because a knowledge indicator is a third mapping dimension alongside programme and programme-specific outcomes — a course outcome maps to POs *and* to WKs — and is not a property of either. NBA's SAR 2025 expects a CO-PO-WK mapping, so treating WK as a field on a PO would make that mapping impossible to express.

The outcome set points here via `knowledge_indicators_ref`, and each outcome cross-references the indicator codes it draws on.

version.description: The framework version these belong to.

applies_to_framework.description: Registry id of the outcome set these indicators accompany.

verified_on.description: Null until a human has checked each statement against the official manual. When null, verification_note is required.

statement.description: Official wording, verbatim — it is reproduced in the SAR mapping tables.

added_in.description: Framework version that introduced this indicator, where it did not exist previously.
